notes.title: patch 0.5 (may contain bugs) now live!
notes.notes:
4th town done!
no more death penalty (cuz why is it in the game in the first place? dont ask me idk :) )
you can now dash through enemy and their attacks!
you can now press S to perform a little drop (previously a item spell, now it is a default movement)
item spell descriptions are now, a bit better (but none of you can read it cuz it's in full Chinese, and also there r probably no English users playing the game so I can write w/e I want here and no one is gonna notice).
You can now turn off in game UI in the settings tab (but not from title screen).
Buffed some items!
See ya in two months (ASSUMING THERE R NO BUGS)
